baseline_construction_method.value: Real EnPI = mean of site-level specific energy consumption (energy per unit of production); a linear regression of energy consumption on production (Energy = a*Production + b) is fitted and accepted as statistically representative when R2>0.5, R>Rcritic (alpha=0.01) and p-value<0.05, giving an EnPI model mean curve with upper/lower bounds from the covariance matrix (2022 reference year; 27 sites, 11 excluded for sample homogeneity).
baseline_construction_method.evidence_quote: If the linear correlation complies with: R2>0.5, R > Rcritic = f (n, α=0.01), and p-value<0.05, so it is considered statistically representative
